entries.en: The sensor recorded rising carbon dioxide levels in the crowded classroom.
entries.zh: 传感器记录到拥挤的教室里二氧化碳浓度不断上升。

entries.en: Investigators detected carbon monoxide in the air near the damaged heater.
entries.zh: 调查人员在损坏的取暖器附近的空气中检测到了一氧化碳。

entries.en: A sheet of carbon paper lay between the two pages of the old order form.
entries.zh: 旧订货单的两页之间夹着一张复写纸。

entries.en: Coffee became the village's main cash crop after the new road opened.
entries.zh: 新公路通车后，咖啡成了村里主要的经济作物。

entries.en: The antique stove was made of cast iron and weighed more than we expected.
entries.zh: 那只古董炉子是铸铁做的，比我们预想的更重。

entries.en: The factory's inventory listed caustic soda among the materials awaiting inspection.
entries.zh: 工厂的库存清单把烧碱列在待检材料之中。

entries.en: The laboratory compared the citric acid content of several fruit juices.
entries.zh: 实验室比较了几种果汁的柠檬酸含量。

entries.en: The restoration team found traces of coal tar on the old timber.
entries.zh: 修复团队在旧木料上发现了煤焦油的痕迹。

entries.en: A coconut palm cast a shifting shadow across the hotel courtyard.
entries.zh: 一棵椰子树在酒店庭院里投下不断移动的影子。

entries.en: An unopened bottle of cod-liver oil stood on the pharmacy museum's shelf.
entries.zh: 药学博物馆的架子上放着一瓶未开封的鳕鱼肝油。

entries.en: The rough mat by the garden door was woven from coir.
entries.zh: 花园门旁那块粗糙的垫子是用椰纤维编织的。

entries.en: The copper beech's dark leaves stood out against the pale stone house.
entries.zh: 紫叶欧洲山毛榉的深色叶片与浅色石屋形成鲜明对比。

entries.en: She padded the model's wooden base with cotton wool before packing it.
entries.zh: 她先用棉絮垫好模型的木制底座，再把它装箱。

entries.en: A coypu slipped into the canal as our bicycles approached.
entries.zh: 我们的自行车靠近时，一只河狸鼠溜进了运河。

entries.en: The baker checked whether the cupboard still held any cream of tartar.
entries.zh: 面包师查看橱柜里是否还有酒石酸氢钾。

entries.en: The children made bright flowers from crepe paper for the school play.
entries.zh: 孩子们用皱纸做了鲜艳的花，供学校演出使用。

entries.en: The tanker carried crude oil from the offshore terminal to the refinery.
entries.zh: 油轮把原油从海上码头运往炼油厂。

entries.en: A daddy longlegs balanced on its thin legs beside the garden wall.
entries.zh: 一只盲蜘蛛用细长的腿支着身体，停在花园围墙旁。

entries.en: The lecture explored how astronomers investigate dark matter without seeing it directly.
entries.zh: 讲座探讨了天文学家如何在无法直接看到暗物质的情况下研究它。

entries.en: The date palm near the courtyard entrance was heavy with fruit.
entries.zh: 庭院入口附近的海枣树上挂满了果实。

entries.en: The ranger identified fresh droppings beside the narrow woodland trail.
entries.zh: 护林员在狭窄的林间小径旁辨认出了新鲜的动物粪便。

entries.en: The food scientist tested how the emulsifier affected the sauce's texture.
entries.zh: 食品科学家测试了这种乳化剂如何影响酱汁的质地。

entries.en: An evening primrose opened its flowers beside the bench at dusk.
entries.zh: 黄昏时，一株月见草在长凳旁绽开了花朵。

entries.en: The field team collected animal faeces for a study of seed dispersal.
entries.zh: 野外调查队收集了动物粪便，用于研究种子的传播。

entries.en: A field mouse darted beneath the shed before the cat noticed it.
entries.zh: 一只田鼠在猫注意到它之前就窜进了棚子底下。

entries.en: The old fir tree sheltered the cabin from the strongest winds.
entries.zh: 那棵老枞树为小木屋挡住了最猛烈的风。

entries.en: A flying fish glided above the waves alongside our boat.
entries.zh: 一条飞鱼在我们船旁的海浪上方滑翔。

entries.en: The nutrition survey compared folic acid levels in the labelled food samples.
entries.zh: 营养调查比较了各份带标签的食品样本中的叶酸含量。

entries.en: The guide showed us fool's gold embedded in a piece of rock.
entries.zh: 导游给我们看了一块岩石中嵌着的黄铁矿。

entries.en: A forget-me-not grew through a crack beside the greenhouse steps.
entries.zh: 温室台阶旁的一条裂缝里长着一株勿忘草。

entries.en: The report compared fossil fuel use across the city's transport network.
entries.zh: 报告比较了全市交通网络中化石燃料的使用情况。

entries.en: The diagram used a coloured dot to mark the free radical's unpaired electron.
entries.zh: 图中用一个彩色圆点标示了这个自由基的未配对电子。

entries.en: A fruit fly hovered over the ripe peaches on the kitchen counter.
entries.zh: 一只果蝇在厨房台面上的熟桃子上方盘旋。

entries.en: The estate's records listed every game bird taken during the season.
entries.zh: 庄园的记录列出了那个狩猎季猎获的每一只猎禽。

entries.en: The quiet gelding waited while the rider tightened the saddle strap.
entries.zh: 骑手收紧鞍带时，那匹温顺的去势雄马静静地等着。

entries.en: A few grains of gold dust glittered at the bottom of the prospector's pan.
entries.zh: 淘金者的淘金盘底有几粒砂金闪闪发亮。

entries.en: She plotted the measurements on graph paper before drawing the curve.
entries.zh: 她先把测量值标在方格纸上，再画出曲线。

entries.en: The bakery wrapped each slice of cake in greaseproof paper.
entries.zh: 面包店用防油纸把每片蛋糕包好。

entries.en: The study tracked greenhouse gas emissions from the region's farms.
entries.zh: 这项研究追踪了该地区农场排放的温室效应气体。

entries.en: The guard dog barked when a stranger approached the warehouse gate.
entries.zh: 一个陌生人靠近仓库大门时，看门狗叫了起来。

entries.en: Her guide dog waited calmly beside her seat on the train.
entries.zh: 她的导盲狗在火车上安静地等在她的座位旁。

entries.en: Several guinea fowl wandered between the trees behind the farmhouse.
entries.zh: 几只珍珠鸡在农舍后面的树间漫步。

entries.en: A gum tree shaded the picnic table beside the campsite.
entries.zh: 一棵产树胶的树为营地旁的野餐桌遮阴。

entries.en: The gun dog returned to its handler when she blew the whistle.
entries.zh: 女训犬员吹响哨子，那只随猎人狩猎的猎狗便回到了她身边。

entries.en: His hearing dog nudged his hand when the doorbell rang.
entries.zh: 门铃响时，他的助聋犬轻轻碰了碰他的手。

entries.en: The military museum displayed an empty container once used for high explosive.
entries.zh: 军事博物馆展出了一个曾用于盛装猛性炸药的空容器。

entries.en: The homing pigeon returned to its loft before sunset.
entries.zh: 那只信鸽在日落前回到了鸽舍。

entries.en: The horse chestnut beside the library lost a large branch in the storm.
entries.zh: 图书馆旁的马栗树在暴风雨中折断了一根大树枝。

entries.en: The robot's camera mistook a mannequin for a human being.
entries.zh: 机器人的摄像头误把人体模型当成了人类。

entries.en: The analyst found hydrochloric acid listed in the laboratory's purchase records.
entries.zh: 分析员在实验室的采购记录中找到了盐酸。

entries.en: The materials study examined how hydrogen peroxide affected the sample's surface.
entries.zh: 这项材料研究考察了过氧化氢对样本表面的影响。

entries.en: A single joss stick burned in the holder beside the temple entrance.
entries.zh: 寺庙入口旁的香座里燃着一炷香。

entries.en: A killer whale surfaced beyond the research boat's stern.
entries.zh: 一头虎鲸在调查船的船尾后方浮出了水面。

entries.en: The researchers measured lactic acid in the fermented milk samples.
entries.zh: 研究人员测量了发酵乳样本中的乳酸含量。

entries.en: The plumber replaced the damaged lagging around the hot-water pipe.
entries.zh: 管道工更换了热水管外受损的保温防护套。

entries.en: The gardener spread leaf mould beneath the newly planted shrubs.
entries.zh: 园丁在新栽的灌木下面铺上了腐叶土。

entries.en: A lightning bug flashed above the lawn as we sat on the porch.
entries.zh: 我们坐在门廊上时，一只萤火虫在草坪上方闪着光。

entries.en: She planted lily of the valley in the shaded bed behind the house.
entries.zh: 她在屋后背阴的花坛里种了铃兰。

entries.en: The painter's account book recorded a delivery of linseed oil.
entries.zh: 画家的账簿上记录了一批送来的亚麻子油。

entries.en: The engineer examined the liquid crystal layer under the microscope.
entries.zh: 工程师在显微镜下检查了液晶层。

entries.en: The exhibition featured a painting of a magic mushroom.
entries.zh: 展览中有一幅描绘致幻蘑菇的画。

entries.en: The congregation gathered in the wooden meeting house each Sunday.
entries.zh: 会众每个星期日都聚集在那座木制礼拜堂里。

entries.en: The box's lid was decorated with delicate mother-of-pearl inlays.
entries.zh: 盒盖上饰有精致的珍珠母镶嵌图案。

entries.en: The trail camera recorded a mountain lion walking along the ridge.
entries.zh: 野外监测相机拍到了一只沿着山脊行走的美洲狮。

entries.en: The historian found references to mustard gas in the soldier's letters.
entries.zh: 历史学家在那名士兵的信中找到了提及芥子气的内容。

entries.en: The athletics tribunal examined the laboratory's report on nandrolone.
entries.zh: 田径仲裁庭审查了实验室关于南诺龙的报告。

entries.en: The village received natural gas through a new underground pipeline.
entries.zh: 天然气通过一条新建的地下管道输送到了村里。

entries.en: The inquiry examined allegations that a nerve agent had been used.
entries.zh: 调查审查了有关使用神经毒剂的指控。

entries.en: The documentary described the fear of nerve gas during the conflict.
entries.zh: 纪录片描述了冲突期间人们对神经毒气的恐惧。

entries.en: The archive held invoices for nitric acid delivered to the old laboratory.
entries.zh: 档案中保存着旧实验室所收硝酸的发票。

entries.en: The regulator requested more detailed records of nuclear fuel storage.
entries.zh: 监管机构要求提供更详细的核燃料储存记录。

entries.en: The technician labelled the tube containing the extracted nucleic acid.
entries.zh: 技术员给装有提取核酸的试管贴上了标签。

entries.en: A pink paeony opened beside the garden's weathered stone bench.
entries.zh: 一株粉红色的芍药在花园里风化的石凳旁绽放。

entries.en: The environmental report recorded paraquat residues in the archived samples.
entries.zh: 环境报告记录了存档样本中的百草枯残留。

entries.en: Her patent leather shoes reflected the lights above the dance floor.
entries.zh: 她的漆革鞋映着舞池上方的灯光。

entries.en: The historical collection included a small tin of petroleum jelly.
entries.zh: 这批历史藏品中有一小罐凡士林。

entries.en: The war memorial included testimony from survivors of a poison gas attack.
entries.zh: 战争纪念馆收录了毒气袭击幸存者的证言。

entries.en: The polar bear crossed the ice toward a distant patch of open water.
entries.zh: 那只北极熊穿过冰面，走向远处一片未结冰的水域。

entries.en: The police dog found the missing backpack beneath a fallen tree.
entries.zh: 警犬在一棵倒下的树下面找到了丢失的背包。

entries.en: He moved the pot plant away from the cold window.
entries.zh: 他把那盆植物从冰冷的窗边移开了。

entries.en: A prairie dog stood upright beside the entrance to its burrow.
entries.zh: 一只草原土拨鼠直立在洞口旁。

entries.en: The geologist weighed a piece of pumice stone from the volcanic beach.
entries.zh: 地质学家称量了一块从火山海滩采来的浮石。

entries.en: The bridge's reinforced concrete pillars survived the flood without visible damage.
entries.zh: 桥梁的钢筋混凝土桥墩经受住了洪水，没有明显损伤。

entries.en: The textbook's diagram illustrated the inheritance of the rhesus factor.
entries.zh: 课本中的示意图说明了Rh因子的遗传方式。

entries.en: The museum displayed a large block of rock salt from a nearby mine.
entries.zh: 博物馆展出了一大块来自附近矿井的岩盐。

entries.en: A roe deer stepped into the clearing and lifted its head.
entries.zh: 一只狍走进林间空地，抬起了头。

entries.en: A red rosehip remained on the bare stem after the leaves had fallen.
entries.zh: 叶子落尽后，光秃的茎上还留着一颗红色蔷薇果。

entries.en: The beekeeper explained how royal jelly is collected during the farm tour.
entries.zh: 参观农场时，养蜂人讲解了蜂王浆的采集过程。

entries.en: The groundskeeper planted rye grass over the worn section of the playing field.
entries.zh: 场地管理员在运动场磨损的区域种上了黑麦草。

entries.en: The architect specified safety glass for the doors beside the school entrance.
entries.zh: 建筑师为学校入口旁的门指定使用安全玻璃。

entries.en: I wrote the unfamiliar address on a scratch pad beside the telephone.
entries.zh: 我把那个陌生地址写在了电话旁的便笺本上。

entries.en: A sea lion slept on the wooden platform below the pier.
entries.zh: 一只海狮在码头下方的木平台上睡觉。

entries.en: The divers watched a sea turtle swimming slowly above the reef.
entries.zh: 潜水员们看着一只海龟在礁石上方缓缓游动。

entries.en: A sea urchin clung to the rock inside the shallow pool.
entries.zh: 一只海胆附着在浅水池内的岩石上。

entries.en: The museum displayed a silver case once used to carry smelling salts.
entries.zh: 博物馆展出了一个曾用来装嗅盐的银盒。

entries.en: The farmer set aside a small field for spelt this season.
entries.zh: 这一季，农民留出了一小块田地种德国小麦。

entries.en: The crew photographed a sperm whale before it began a deep dive.
entries.zh: 船员们在一头抹香鲸开始深潜之前拍下了它。

entries.en: Sunlight passing through the stained glass coloured the chapel floor.
entries.zh: 阳光穿过彩色玻璃，把小教堂的地面映成了彩色。

entries.en: The new kitchen sink was made from stainless steel.
entries.zh: 新的厨房水槽是不锈钢做的。

entries.en: A grain of pollen clung to the tip of the stamen.
entries.zh: 一粒花粉附着在雄蕊顶端。

entries.en: The restorer found fragments of steel wool inside the old tool chest.
entries.zh: 修复师在旧工具箱里发现了钢丝绒碎屑。

entries.en: The stick insect was almost invisible among the thin brown twigs.
entries.zh: 那只竹节虫夹在细细的褐色树枝之间，几乎看不出来。

entries.en: The truck carried freshly cut sugar cane from the field to the mill.
entries.zh: 卡车把刚砍下的甘蔗从田里运到了加工厂。

entries.en: The inspection report noted a discrepancy in the sulfuric acid inventory.
entries.zh: 检查报告指出硫酸的库存记录存在一处差异。

entries.en: The archive contained an old invoice for sulphuric acid.
entries.zh: 档案中有一张购买硫酸的旧发票。

entries.en: The medical history exhibit included an unopened bottle of surgical spirit.
entries.zh: 医学史展览中有一瓶未开封的外科用酒精。

entries.en: A sweet pea climbed the trellis outside her bedroom window.
entries.zh: 一株香豌豆攀上了她卧室窗外的花架。

entries.en: The news footage showed tear gas drifting across the empty square.
entries.zh: 新闻画面中，催泪瓦斯在空荡的广场上飘散。

entries.en: The botanist photographed a teasel beside the mountain path.
entries.zh: 植物学家在山路旁拍下了一株川续断。

entries.meaningZh: 彩带〔庆祝游行时撒下的纸带〕
entries.en: Ticker tape drifted from the windows as the victorious team passed below.
entries.zh: 获胜队伍从楼下经过时，庆祝的纸彩带从窗口飘落。

entries.en: The caretaker replenished the toilet paper before the visitors arrived.
entries.zh: 管理员在游客到来前补充了卫生纸。

entries.en: She put a spare toilet roll in the cupboard beneath the sink.
entries.zh: 她把一卷备用卫生纸放进了洗手池下面的柜子里。

entries.en: The researchers compared trace element concentrations in the two soil samples.
entries.zh: 研究人员比较了两份土壤样本中的痕量元素浓度。

entries.en: He placed tracing paper over the sketch to copy the curved outline.
entries.zh: 他把描图纸覆在草图上，描下了弯曲的轮廓。

entries.en: The fallen tree trunk blocked the narrow road through the forest.
entries.zh: 倒下的树干挡住了穿过森林的狭窄道路。

entries.en: The entomologist examined a tsetse fly from the survey collection.
entries.zh: 昆虫学家检查了调查采集的一只采采蝇。

entries.en: The documentary followed a vampire bat leaving its roost after dark.
entries.zh: 纪录片跟拍了一只天黑后离开栖息处的吸血蝠。

entries.en: The tailor added a thin layer of wadding to the jacket's shoulders.
entries.zh: 裁缝在夹克的肩部加了一层薄薄的软填料。

entries.en: A water bird disappeared among the reeds at the edge of the lake.
entries.zh: 一只水鸟消失在了湖边的芦苇丛中。

entries.en: The farmer led a water buffalo along the muddy path between the fields.
entries.zh: 农民牵着一头水牛走在田间泥泞的小路上。

entries.en: A white water lily floated beside the pond's wooden bridge.
entries.zh: 一朵白色睡莲浮在池塘的木桥旁。

entries.en: She separated the layers of handmade chocolates with wax paper.
entries.zh: 她用蜡纸把一层层手工巧克力隔开。

entries.en: The weeping willow's branches brushed the surface of the canal.
entries.zh: 垂柳的枝条轻拂着运河的水面。

entries.en: Fresh tracks showed where a wild boar had crossed the muddy lane.
entries.zh: 新鲜的足迹表明，一头野猪曾从那里穿过泥泞的小路。

entries.en: She stopped to draw a wild flower growing beside the trail.
entries.zh: 她停下来，画了一株长在小径旁的野花。

entries.en: A small bundle of wire wool lay beside the tins of polish.
entries.zh: 几罐抛光剂旁放着一小团钢丝绒。

entries.en: The paper mill received wood pulp by rail from another province.
entries.zh: 造纸厂通过铁路收到了从外省运来的木浆。

entries.en: He saved the patterned wrapping paper after opening the present.
entries.zh: 他拆开礼物后，把带图案的包装纸留了下来。

entries.zh: 她选了奶油色信纸，给祖母写信。

entries.zh: 铁匠修好了老房子外面的锻铁门。

entries.en: The technician compared the abrasive material with a finer commercial product.
entries.zh: 技术员把这种磨料与一种更细的市售产品作了比较。

entries.zh: 温室收藏中有几种爵床科植物。

entries.zh: 讲座最后一张幻灯片展示了凝血第五因子在血液凝固中的作用。

entries.zh: 植物学课上用苹果作为假果的例子。

entries.zh: 退潮后，一只藤壶仍附着在岩石上。

entries.zh: 制造商测试了一种拟用于透明盖板的丙烯酸酯树脂。

entries.en: The engineer tested whether the adhesive agent could bond the two surfaces securely.
entries.zh: 工程师测试了这种附着剂能否牢固地粘合两个表面。

entries.en: A layer of adhesive material remained beneath the removed label.
entries.zh: 标签揭下后，下方还留着一层附着剂。

entries.en: An adjutant bird stood beside the water while smaller birds searched the mud.
entries.zh: 一只秃鹳站在水边，旁边的小鸟正在泥中觅食。

entries.en: The researchers compared the adsorbent material with activated carbon.
entries.zh: 研究人员把这种吸附材料与活性炭作了比较。

entries.en: An adsuki bean plant grew in the demonstration plot beside the school.
entries.zh: 学校旁的示范田里长着一株赤豆。

entries.en: The farmer inspected an adzuki bean plant near the end of the row.
entries.zh: 农民检查了那一行末端附近的一株赤豆。

entries.en: The older catalogue placed these specimens in the agave family.
entries.zh: 那本较早的目录把这些标本归入龙舌兰科。

entries.en: The botanical illustration showed the small units that make up an aggregate fruit.
entries.zh: 植物学插图展示了构成聚合果的各个小单元。

entries.en: The botanist recorded ague weed near the edge of the woodland clearing.
entries.zh: 植物学家在林间空地边缘附近记录到了五叶龙胆。

entries.en: An ailanthus silkworm moved slowly along the leaf's central vein.
entries.zh: 一条樗蚕沿着叶片的中脉缓慢爬行。

entries.en: The illustration showed the fish's air bladder above its digestive organs.
entries.zh: 插图展示了这条鱼消化器官上方的气囊。

entries.en: The industrial archive contained records of air gas production at the old works.
entries.zh: 工业档案中保存着旧工厂生产风煤气的记录。

entries.en: Alder buckthorn grew along the damp boundary of the nature reserve.
entries.zh: 自然保护区潮湿的边界沿线长着药炭鼠李。

entries.en: A streak of alizarin crimson brightened the otherwise grey painting.
entries.zh: 画面中一抹深茜红为原本灰暗的画增添了亮色。

entries.en: The teacher asked which alkaline-earth metal belonged in the empty box on the chart.
entries.zh: 老师问，图表中的空格应该填入哪种碱土金属。

entries.en: The diagram highlighted the alkyl group attached to the central structure.
entries.zh: 示意图突出标示了连接在中央结构上的烷基。

entries.en: The analyst identified an alkyl halide in the archived chemical sample.
entries.zh: 分析员在存档的化学样本中鉴定出了一种卤代烷。

entries.en: The fisheries survey recorded an allis shad near the river mouth.
entries.zh: 渔业调查在河口附近记录到了一条西鲱。

entries.en: The foundry supplied alloy iron for the replacement machinery parts.
entries.zh: 铸造厂为替换用的机械零件提供了合金铸铁。

entries.en: The engineer chose alloy steel for the heavily loaded shaft.
entries.zh: 工程师为承受重载的轴选用了合金钢。

entries.en: The geographer collected alluvial soil from several points along the river.
entries.zh: 地理学家在河流沿线的几个地点采集了冲积土。

entries.en: The chemist marked the allyl group on the displayed molecular model.
entries.zh: 化学家在展示的分子模型上标出了烯丙基。

entries.en: The inspector found an almond moth beside a damaged sack of grain.
entries.zh: 检查人员在一袋破损的谷物旁发现了一只粉斑螟。

entries.en: The almond tree flowered before the other trees in the orchard.
entries.zh: 那棵扁桃比果园里的其他树更早开花。

entries.en: The metallurgist compared the alpha brass sample with another copper alloy.
entries.zh: 冶金学家把这份阿伐黄铜样本与另一种铜合金作了比较。

entries.en: The museum's analysis identified alpha bronze in the small decorative fitting.
entries.zh: 博物馆的分析在那个装饰性小配件中鉴定出了阿伐青铜。
